newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona air cargo traffic up 12 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona air cargo traffic up 12 pct in August.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Barcelona airport was 12.3 percent higher in August at 5,184 tonnes against 4,617 tonnes in August 1995, airport figures show.

This takes the accumulated total to 49,924 tonnes, an increase of 18.1 percent over the same period last year. International traffic has shown the strongest growth so far this year with monthly increases of at least 20 percent while domestic traffic has been unchanged or shown only modest growth.
Domestic traffic fell slightly in August to 2,313 tonnes from 2,330 last year and the eight month figure was 5.2 percent higher at 20,996 tonnes.
Passenger numbers were 20.1 percent higher in the month at 1.24 million, excluding transit passengers. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
